question: Can all archived organoid lines, including the three differently named controls, be assigned to distinct source mice, and do the counts and overlapping clone IDs recover the caption denominator?
decision: Resolve remaining S0 identifiers for review, retaining every deposited clone membership. Stop before biological estimation.
strongest_rival: Identical clone labels across lines and different aliases for the same control mouse create false independence or apparent missing animals.
discriminator: Require single-valued barcode-based line-to-specimen and specimen-to-donor identity, concordant history for every score membership, and independent raw long-table and comma-separated clean-call reconciliation.
exposure_record: The published counts, S0 v1 failure, S0 v2 outputs and preliminary source-ID, token cardinality and nonfinite-score checks are known. This is an exposed metadata reconciliation, without an effect estimate.
biological_unit: Tissue mouse and organoid donor mouse are history units; clone, cell, specimen, well, lesion, section, motif locus and assay preparation are distinct where present.
nesting_and_overlap: Track donor identity in its specimen context. Preserve every multi-clone assignment and raw sample label. Tissue and organoid data, staining and spatial lesion measurements are separate specimens unless keyed.
population_and_selection: Every clean organoid call and released feature row in Supplementary Data 2; all tissue RNA barcodes and the saved fragment previews summarized in S0 v2.
contrast: Compare biological identity by independent barcode and literal alias routes; compare clone cardinality by history to global names and published minimum cell count.
endpoint: Full cell-to-clone-to-line-to-specimen-to-donor table, line key, repeated IDs, finite Fos denominator, feature missingness and tissue map resolution by stage.
methods: Python standard library. Independently split raw clean calls, scan all score rows, check finite Fos for every released cell-clone-history record, join barcode specimens to the sourced donor key and compare source history. Do not normalize differing aliases by name. Summarize tissue mapping ambiguity in main/extended release separately.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain all clean-only entries, all overlapping tokens, all nonfinite feature scores and unresolved tissue samples; no biological exclusions or reallocation.
multiplicity: No effect estimates, hypothesis testing or significance decisions at S0.
precision_basis: Deterministic deposited record counts and key checks; fragment barcode coverage applies only to the explicitly saved prefixes.
interpretation_limit: Qualification establishes identity in the indicated deposited source only. It cannot establish a change in protein, chromatin, repair or tumour growth or independent experimental replication.
stop_rule: Stop if raw clean or scored membership keys disagree, any line has multiple barcode specimens/donors, mapped history disagrees with the score record or finite Fos coverage differs across the key sets. Do not use a similarity estimate as a substitute for a specimen key.
amendment_reason: Add an S0 key reconciliation using completed S0 lookup results. Three control lines have different literal archive and portal aliases; use their exact barcode-matched specimen and donor. Resolve the caption counting convention and preserve cross-line tokens.
